headlines.title: Airbnb vs. Booking: Which Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Booking runs one of the most consistent businesses in travel with free cash flow growing every quarter. Airbnb is more innovative and culturally resonant, but less predictable.

headlines.title: Destin, 30A and Panama City Beach Short Term Rental Realtors Pass $500 Million in Airbnb Sales
headlines.summary: The Short Term Shop, the largest short term rental-specialized real estate brokerage in the United States, has helped investors buy more than $500 million in Airbnb and short term rental properties in Destin, 30A and Panama City Beach. As the short term rental tax strategy draws more buyers to these beach markets, one decision matters more than ever: which realtor should investors trust with a purchase that often exceeds $1 million?

headlines.title: Up 10% in the Last Two Weeks, Is Airbnb the Perfect Stock for Today's Market?
headlines.summary: Airbnb is finally outperforming, and it looks as resilient as ever.

headlines.title: Utah police raided an Airbnb with guns drawn over stolen Legos, found nothing — and taxpayers will pay for it
headlines.summary: An $80,000 Lego collection was allegedly stolen. When a YouTuber went to track down the thief, he and his helpers were raided by the police instead.

headlines.title: Why Airbnb, Inc. (ABNB) Outpaced the Stock Market Today
headlines.summary: In the latest trading session, Airbnb, Inc. (ABNB) closed at $175.46, marking a +1.01% move from the previous day.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
